company_name: Plug and Play Kyoto / Kyoto City
semiconductor_relevance: High — FLOSFIA is directly involved in the development of advanced power semiconductors using gallium oxide.
summary: FLOSFIA, a spin-off from Kyoto University, focuses on the development and commercialization of gallium oxide (Ga2O3) power semiconductors. The company utilizes its proprietary MISTDRYTM technology for film-formation via mist chemical vapor deposition, aiming to reduce power loss significantly in semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Development of gallium oxide (Ga2O3) power semiconductors
MISTDRYTM technology for mist chemical vapor deposition
Schottky Barrier Diode with low specific on-resistance
Exploration of applications in electrode materials and oxide compounds

regional_presence.Japan: FLOSFIA is based in Kyoto, Japan, and is in the process of establishing its own production lines there.
